create_AmazonReviews2014_dataset: create an AmazonReviews2014 dataset instance by passing a config dict with category and cache_dir keys
download_raw_reviews_and_metadata: download raw Amazon review and metadata JSON gz files from Stanford SNAP for a given category
process_reviews_to_item_sequences: process raw review data into user-item sequences with remapped integer IDs starting from 1
extract_meta_sentences_from_items: extract structured meta sentences from item metadata fields like title, price, brand, and description
parse_gzipped_json_lines: parse a gzipped JSON lines file and yield each line as a Python dict with boolean fixes
